podcast.body: Carol K played on the song "Faith in You" from Matthew Sweet's 1999 album "In Reverse." Her contribution as a Wrecking Crew bass player further solidified her legacy as one of the most important and most heard bass players in rock history. "Matthew Sweet and Faith in You featuring Reckon Crew bass player Carol K, one of the most important and most heard bass players in the history of rock."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
